### Added
- **Every emptyDir of a model pod has a sizeLimit** (giantswarm/agent-platform#556). The serving policies bound the volumes KServe composes into the pod and into its Deployment's template — `dshm` at `modelServing.serving.shmSizeLimit` (`8Gi`, room for tensor parallelism), the download's volume at `modelCacheSizeLimit` (`100Gi`) when the cache is off, every other one at `emptyDirSizeLimit` (`1Gi`) — so Kyverno's `require-emptydir-requests-and-limits` audit no longer reports a served model's pod and Deployment. A `modelCacheSizeLimit` below an `hf://` preset's weights fails the render.
